name: Products Grid for Elementor
author: Best WP Developer

sections.description:
Products Grid is the ultimate Elementor addon plugin designed to help you beautifully display your WooCommerce products. Whether you’re running a small store or a large-scale eCommerce site, this plugin gives you the flexibility to present your products in a visually compelling way.

🎯 With 2 FREE unique designs and 20+ PRO layouts, you can create modern and engaging product grids to attract more customers and boost sales. Perfect for Elementor users who want to upgrade their product display without writing a single line of code!

Features

✅ Free Version Includes:

  • 🧩 2 Stylish Product Grid Layouts – Choose from two professionally designed layouts to enhance your store’s appearance.
  • ⚡ Elementor Widget Support – Fully integrated with Elementor, making it easy to drag and drop.
  • 📱 Responsive Design – Optimized for all devices: desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • 🎨 Basic Styling Options – Customize font, colors, padding, spacing and more.
  • 🧑‍🎓 Beginner-Friendly – No coding skills required.
  • 💡 Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance.

🔐 Pro Version Includes:

  • 🚀 20+ Premium Product Grid Layouts – Access a wide variety of advanced, modern, and niche-specific designs.
  • 🌈 Advanced Styling Controls – More control over typography, hover effects, buttons, badges, and more.
  • 🌀 Grid Layouts – Multiple layout types to suit your product needs.
  • 🧩 Custom Badge and Sale Tag Options – Highlight special offers or discounts visually.
  • 🔍 Filtering and Sorting Options – Let users browse through categories or sort by popularity, price, etc.
  • 🎯 Hover Animations and Interactions
  • 🛠️ Premium Support – Get dedicated support from our expert team.
  • 🧾 All Free Features Included

External Libraries

This plugin uses the following external CSS library via CDN:

  • Bootstrap 5.2.0
    • Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bootstrap/5.2.0/css/bootstrap.min.css
    • License: MIT License
    • Purpose: For layout structure and responsive design support.

How to Use

  1. Edit any page with Elementor.
  2. Find the “Products Grid” widget in the Elementor sidebar.
  3. Drag and drop the widget into your layout.
  4. Choose from available layouts.
  5. Add your WooCommerce products and adjust the styling options.
  6. Save and preview the changes.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. You are free to use, modify, and distribute it under the same license terms. See GPLv2 for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress Admin:

    • Go to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
    • Search for “Products Grid.”
    • Click “Install Now” and then activate the plugin.

  2. Install via FTP:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Unzip the file.
    • Upload the extracted folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Go to your WordPress admin panel and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes! It works with any theme that supports Elementor and WooCommerce.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No. The plugin works perfectly with the free version of Elementor.

Can I upgrade to the Pro version?

Yes. The Pro version unlocks 20+ extra layouts and advanced customization options. Visit our website for more info.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Products Grid is optimized for performance and is lightweight by design.
